prompt: What was the first-generation, four-speed manual transmission gearbox type of the Mazda R360 officially called in Japan?
answer: The first-generation Mazda R360’s four-speed manual version was officially designated **KRBB** in Japan. (The two-speed Torque Drive automatic was designated **KRBC**.)
